name: SmartArtColor
description: Chooses the color scheme for the SmartArt diagram.
remarks: Simulates the commands on the Microsoft Office Fluent Ribbon user interface on the SmartArt Tools tab, on the Design group, and on the Change Colors command.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SmartArtColor object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Retrieves the unique Id of the associated SmartArt color style. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Retrieves the string name of the SmartArt color style. Read-only.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Retrieves the description of the SmartArt color style. Read-only.

properties.name: Category
properties.description: Retrieves the primary category name associated with the SmartArt color style. Read-only.
